items.quote: Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services.
Relevant experience in similar assignments (including in the audit of companies);
Technical and managerial capabilities of firm;
The Consultants shall have a valid license from Ministry of Finance of Republic of Tajikistan for u undertaking the Services.
setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest and eligibility
Consultants may associate with other firms to enhance their qualifications, but should indicate clearly whether the association is in the form of a joint venture and/or a sub-consultancy.
In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected.
A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Least Cost Selection (LCS) procedures
Expressions of interest must be submitted to the emails below by December 9th, 2025.
